payout_quote: Fill out the logo questionnaire and post a prize. Designers submit their ideas, while you provide feedback and rankings. Select your favorite, and download your logo files
steps: Create a free LogoTournament designer account.
Browse live logo contests during the open phase.
Submit original logo designs per the contest brief and iterate on client feedback and rankings.
Survive the open phase into the top-5 and judging phases if ranked highly.
As the winner, deliver final files and receive the posted prize (minus the platform's 15% fee per third-party reporting; confirm in current terms).
catches: Only the winner is paid — most entries earn nothing.
Prize is set per contest by the client; typical packages are a few hundred dollars, split among winners if a split is required.
A 15% platform fee comes out of the prize (per PCWorld's account of the flow).
Contests draw 100+ entries; winning is not guaranteed.
Rights transfer to the client on award.
biggest_catch: Winner-takes-all spec work: with 100+ entries per contest, almost every design you submit earns you nothing.
eligibility: Free designer account; logo designers able to deliver vector files.
timing: Contests run about 7 days with judging phases; prize after winner selection and file approval.
